simple.meaning: תָּנָה (tânâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to ascribe (praise), i.e. celebrate , commemorate.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Judges, beginning at Judges 5:11. The surrounding contexts include family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תָּנָה (H8567) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תָּנָה (tânâh) / H8567 is traced through Judges 5:11, Judges 11:40 with source-language evidence and verse context.
